messages:
erin: Heads up — spotted a regression in seq-batching on prod (v1.12.2) that can cause duplicated tokens under heavy concurrency. We should do a minimal patch cut tomorrow at 10:00 PDT. Target bump to 1.12.3. Who can pick up cherry-picks + changelog?
mat: I can take the cherry-pick and open the patch PR. Will target a small change against release/1.12.2 and then backport to main. ETA ~2h.
shaun: I can handle smoke and perf runs once there's a PR. Any DB or migration work?
erin: No DB migrations — this is a runtime KV cache guard fix. Minimal diff. Mat pls include failing test and reproduction steps in the PR.
mat: Opening now — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5423. Includes cherry-pick + unit test. CC @shaun @tia.
tia: Changelog blurb suggestion: "Fix: KV cache edge case causing token duplication under heavy batching." OK to squash? :white_check_mark:
shaun: Running quick perf on staging branch. If green I'll promote a canary to 10% traffic. ETA ~45m after PR is merged.
erin: Cutoff note: close non-critical PRs to release/1.12.2 by 09:30 PDT so we keep the cut minimal and reviewable. @mat any other backports we should consider?
mat: No other backports planned. I'll bump the patch to 1.12.3 in the release branch and add the changelog fragment.
tia: Also remember to update bundle hashes and add the short note to /docs/changelog/1.12.3.md (fragment under changelog-fragments/).
devops-bot: CI for PR 5423 passed: all checks green — build, unit, integration, e2e smoke. :tada:
shaun: Smoke run on staging looks good. Latency within baseline; memory stable. There's one unrelated flaky test in decoder_cache that I'll follow up on in a separate thread.
erin: Nice. Plan: merge by 09:45 PDT, canary at 10:30, full roll at 11:00 if canary looks good. Mat — please merge + tag and then ping here with tag and release notes URL.
mat: Merging and tagging now. Tag: v1.12.3-patch.0. Pushed changelog fragment and release notes draft.
devops-bot: Release published: v1.12.3 at https://releases.redwood.ai/v1.12.3 :rocket:
erin: Thanks team — will monitor canary and update status. If anything regresses, we abort and roll back; otherwise final release roll at 11:00.
